look_here_first: Start with life cycle, foliage, and ray pattern. Rock tickseed is an annual with narrow linear leaves and slender branching stems; the yellow ray florets usually carry rusty-red/brown color at the base.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow ray florets with rusty-red to maroon basal markings

lookalikes.differences: Compared with C. basalis, C. wrightii is generally narrower-leaved and often more slender, with the classic yellow rays carrying basal reddish-brown marks. Because older floras merge the taxa, final ID should use a full character set rather than ray color alone.
